## 16 Machine-Checked Lean 4.35.0 Statements (19 Audited Declarations; Zero Mathlib, Zero Sorry in built modules, Strictly [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound])
- T1a (ApollonianReciprocity.lean): Classical Descartes Lorentzian form, 4 involutions, Gaussian norm (a+b)(a+c)=a^2+k^2, Brahmagupta-Descartes BQF identity (lemma for T1c).
- T1b (JacobiReciprocity.lean): Self-contained zero-Mathlib Legendre-Jacobi symbol, Eisenstein (1844) Gauss Quadratic Reciprocity, supplementary laws (-1/n) and (2/n), multiplicativity, squares=1.
- T1c (ApollonianReciprocity.lean): Zero-Mathlib parabolic Dehn-twist CRT formalization of the HKRS (Annals of Math. 2024) square obstruction for the three packings (-3,5,8,8), (-7,17,12,20), (-11,21,24,28); contrast rootSquareContrast=(-4,8,9,9) has Descartes form 0 and contains 9 (still has HKRS 3n^2, 6n^2, n^4, 4n^4 obstructions; mod-24 comparison is computational).
- T1d (ApollonianReciprocity.lean): Octahedral 8 involutions, sqrt(-2) norm identity, mod-8 locking (2,2,1,0,0,1) on (-6,10,17,40,24,17) excluding squares at b1,b2 and twice-squares at b3,b6, plus 5 standalone closed Jacobi evaluations (no reciprocity proof formalized; cf. Shi et al., arXiv:2510.21702).
- T1e (ApollonianReciprocity.lean): Divisibility fact (d-1) | 2 <=> d=2 or d=3 (used in LMW 2002; not linked in Lean to general d-dim reflections), all five 3D Soddy involutions preserving soddy3Q (v2.0.0), plus 3D cluster (-6,13,13,13,18) reflecting to 25=5^2.
- T2a (SandpileTropical.lean): Toppling commutativity (Dhar 1990), discrete least-action bound, and uniqueness of legal stabilizing traces for SandpileGraph (symmetric zero-diagonal adjacency, arbitrary degrees, no sink condition, no termination theorem).
- T2b (SandpileTropical.lean): Direct Lean determinants det4(gridLap 2)=192 and detMat 9(gridLap 3)=100,352 (v2.0.0), D_4 block similarity with product 100,352, and explicit legal Dhar toppling traces on 2x2 and 3x3 Z^2 grids (no Matrix-Tree or group-identity theorem formalized).
- T2c (SandpileTropical.lean): Discrete torus Green's First Identity and one isotropic Z^2 superharmonic obstruction (4u = 3(x^2+y^2)+psi, lapZ2 u <= 3 -> False), plus constant Laplacian 2 and 3 witnesses (not full LPS classification).
- T2d (SandpileTropical.lean, elementary parity lemma, no prior statement found): If M>=1, psi doubly periodic, M*u = A*x^2+B*x*y+C*y^2+D*x+E*y+psi, M*K = 4A-2B+4C, and Δ_{A2} u <= K everywhere, then K % 2 = 0 (excluding K=5 in this class; K=4,2 attained; says nothing about height-5 sandpile configurations).
- T2e (SandpileTropical.lean): Elementary lattice-polygon edge-normal closure identity sum R_90(v_{i+1}-v_i)=(0,0), 2x2 determinant identity for v1+v2+v3=(0,0), and closed numeric checks (Kalinin-Shkolnikov theorem not formalized).
- T2f (SandpileTropical.lean, v2.0.0): Direct Lean determinants det4(a2GridLap 2)=1,092 and detMat 9(a2GridLap 3)=5,393,920, Klein-4 block similarity (7*28*40*688), and explicit legal A_2 Dhar toppling traces on 2x2 ([4,3,3,4]) and 3x3 ([4,2,3,2,0,2,3,2,4]) (no Matrix-Tree or group-identity theorem formalized).
- T3a (MarkovHurwitzCluster.lean): Classical SL_2(Z) Fricke trace identity and Cohn binary tree from A_0=((1,1),(1,2)), B_0=((1,2),(2,5)) exporting explicit 3|tr A, 3|tr B, 3|tr(AB) (v2.0.0) and Markov triples via tr/3 (Cohn 1955).
- T3b (MarkovHurwitzCluster.lean): For Markov tree triples from (1,1,1): pairwise coprimality, odd prime p=1 (mod 4), odd m=1 (mod 4), and zero-Mathlib formalization of Ying Zhang's theorem (Acta Arith. 128 (2007) 295-301, arXiv:math/0612620) that even m=2 (mod 32), with witnesses (2,1,1) and (34,13,1).
- T3c (MarkovHurwitzCluster.lean): Standard Hensel uniqueness of sqrt(-1) mod p^k for every odd prime p and k >= 1.
- T3d (MarkovHurwitzCluster.lean): 5-step Markov quiver exchange identities with subtraction-free numerators (divisions by P1, P2) along the path through (2,5,29), (5,29,433), (29,433,37666); proves value positivity at positive integers (coefficient positivity by inspection; finite instance of FZ 2002 / LS 2015).
- T3e (MarkovHurwitzCluster.lean): Classical Hurwitz (1907) n=4 admissible-coefficient classification (a=1 all entries = 2 mod 4; a=4 all odd; a in {2,3} and a >= 5 empty; Vieta-orbit description not in export).
